question: The Gochi festival is predominantly celebrated in which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gochi Festival:-**

 
 
• **It is a fertility festival celebrated in the Chandra and Bhaga valleys of Lahaul and Spiti district in Himachal Pradesh, India. **
 
• It is celebrated by families who have been blessed with a baby boy in the past year.
 
• **The festival is usually celebrated during the month of February every year.**
 
• The Gochi festival is a time for celebration and merrymaking.
 
• Families gather in the houses of those who have had a baby boy, and feast on delicious food and drink chhang, a local wine. There is also music and dancing, and traditional games are played.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
